title: High-dose Chemotherapy With Rituximab for Adults With Aggressive Large B-cell Lymphoma
brief_summary: A prospective pilot trial was proposed to patients with DLBCL, with IH or high adjusted IPI, up to the age of 60 y.o. This program consisted of 2 courses of high-dose R-CHOP-like regimen, followed by a course of high-dose methotrexate with cytarabin. For patients who achieved at least a PR, ASCT started with a BEAM regimen.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 to 60 y.o
* Aggressive Large B-Cell Lymphoma (CD20+)
* Ann Arbor stage III, IV
* IH or high adjusted IPI
* signed inform consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 ou \> 60 y.o
* other type of lymphoma
* serology VIH +
* other neoplasms apart from basal cell carcinoma or situ carcinoma
